outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of APRI, NLR, and PLR in diagnosing COVID-19
cohort: This study included pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 via RT-PCR and a control group of the same number of healthy pregnant women matched for age, BMI, and gestational week without any systemic disease.
finding: The APRI score showed promise as a potential tool for predicting COVID-19 infection in pregnant women, demonstrating good sensitivity and specificity.
gest_age: Not mentioned, but pregnant women were included in the study
